title: Stables behind Moira house.
html_source: Where Fitzgerald and his wife use to meet

anchor.prefix: angement. Gaming at Daly's. No cardsharping then. One of those fellows got his hand nailed to the table by a dagger. Somewhere here lord Edward Fitzgerald escaped from major Sirr.
